statement: The original arithmetic Host/Base, actual selected auxiliary/SQ primes, I.Ok, Pins, Laws, ColW, Over and Forced guards, FieldOK and the prescribed period root. These are precisely the original stage endpoint antecedents, not a newly assumed compatibility record.

The original true-volume/Haar normalization premise retained in the completed GV19 proof. GCF14 uses GV19 at that exact scope, without asserting a new normalization theorem or a completed global measured/Bessel setting.

Finite-dimensional linear algebra, completions and restricted products, Dedekind ideal invertibility and local bases, density of a number field in a completion, elementary finite torsion linear algebra, and field-embedding extension. The elliptic uniformization, invariant and CM-action dictionaries are inherited numbered human claims PA1/PA2 and TA1/TA5/TA11, not silently reclassified as external results.

Only GCF17-18 retain actual WPt realizations with the joint (D,O) and dependent (Gt,cmp,tw,ker) equalities, or the original TSel selector. GCF14 supplies the full GIs2 column stage; it does not by itself supply every other Wit field or identify an arbitrary supplied FamP with these stages.

The original D3(3,A)=Des(WithChN(A),3) class, sufficient coefficient region and Closed quantifier order. Its ChosenE field is actually projected to TopsF/Adm2F; this is no longer an independent producer once membership is given. The TSel/common-realization premise remains separate.
